QUA-01.requirement: The code compiles, follows the project's coding rules with no warnings, and passes its unit tests.

QUA-02.requirement: The work consortium staff do in the application works in a real browser, with the service it talks to simulated.

QUA-03.requirement: The application works from the web address it is deployed under, and when the hosting platform's loader starts it.

ACC-01.requirement: The application meets WCAG 2.2 level AA.

PERF-01.requirement: What every page downloads before it can be used stays within a fixed budget.

PERF-02.requirement: Pages do not move about as they load.

SEC-01.requirement: No password, key or token is committed to the code or anywhere in its history.

SEC-02.requirement: No library the application ships with has a known security flaw of high severity or worse.

SEC-03.requirement: The application runs under a strict Content Security Policy, and the policy blocks nothing the application needs.

SEC-04.requirement: The deployed container image sends its security headers from every address it serves.

SEC-05.requirement: Every library the application ships with is under a licence we have approved for it.

PRIV-01.requirement: A patron's barcode, a request's token and what the service sent back are never written to the browser's console.

PRIV-02.requirement: No patron barcode is kept in the browser's local storage, session storage or cookies.

OPS-01.requirement: The deployed container image compresses what it sends and caches each file for the right length of time.
